reason: The cited evidence confirms that high configurational entropy can favor solid-solution phases in HEAs and that refractory HEAs can have good high-temperature properties, but it provides no data on the specific WTaTiVZr alloy, its toughness, or a direct comparison with pure tungsten, leaving key premises unsupported.
premises: High configurational entropy in equimolar WTaTiVZr promotes a solid-solution phase
Solid-solution phase enhances plastic strain and toughness relative to pure tungsten
Refractory HEAs exhibit superior high-temperature mechanical properties
The cited alloy (NbTaHfTiZrV0.5) is representative of WTaTiVZr behavior
